$comment: Provider protocol cr-provider/1 (contracts 3.14.0, CV-CRPROP; cosmic-ray propagation plan r3 5.2): how a caller asks a propagation provider (a closed form, an external code, an emulator) for unmodulated predictions at parameter points. Not an artifact type: the declaration is the optional 'provider' field of adapter.json and profile.json; the request and the response are files or JSON Lines exchanged with the provider entrypoint ('--request FILE --response FILE', or '--serve'). Parameter names are the canonical theory parameter names (D0_cm2_s, L_kpc, delta, ...). 'want' holds only lis and components: providers never modulate. Each prediction is the extension of a prediction artifact (ext_prediction.json); components are defined here, never as undeclared prediction fields. A failed result carries a reason (out-of-domain, provider-failed, ...) and no prediction. The core runner (core/provider) checks the same rules without reading this file; tests keep the two in agreement.

axis.$comment: rigidity in GV; ekn: kinetic energy per nucleon in GeV/n

reason.$comment: a short reason code: out-of-domain, unknown-parameter, unregistered-provider, provider-version-mismatch, unsupported-want, not-decomposable, unsupported-observable, invalid-request, invalid-response, provider-failed, provider-timeout, provider-error

entrypoint.$comment: relative to the folder of the adapter.json or profile.json that declares it

version.$comment: the provider version requests name; default: the declaring adapter's or profile's version

domain.$comment: canonical parameter name -> the declared range; a point outside it is refused (out-of-domain) unless the caller allows outside-validated-range

axis_ranges.$comment: optional: axis -> the range the bins must lie in (GV or GeV/n)

bins.$comment: [low, high] per bin, increasing and contiguous (high of one bin = low of the next)

transport.$comment: the fixed transport settings in canonical units (theory-spec transport block); part of the point hash

component.$comment: one additive piece of an observable's prediction in the same bins: a primary term, a production channel parent -> daughter (norm-type reweighting multiplies it), or an energy-basis response of a channel for one source-energy bin (slope-type reweighting)

computational_run_ref.$comment: the computational-run artifact of an external run; null for an in-process closed form

input_hash.$comment: sha256 of the point hash object (core.provider.hashing.point_hash)

numerical_tolerance.$comment: relative numerical accuracy the provider states for its values
